title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the essential corridors and micro-districts surrounding Boston College, from the bustling transit hubs of Brighton to the scenic reservoir paths of Chestnut Hill.

cards.title: The Hub of Three T Lines
cards.subtitle: Beacon Street and Chestnut Hill Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this major transit and dining hub where the B, C, and D Green Lines converge, offering easy access to the city and local staples like Eagle's Deli.
cards.short_summary: A central transit and social hub for BC students located at the intersection of Beacon Street and Chestnut Hill Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Cleveland Circle is a major hangout for BC students, featuring popular eateries like Eagle's Deli and access to three MBTA Green Line branches.
cards.source_title: Student Life & Support - Lynch School of Education and Human Development
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the BC Shuttle or a short walk from the Reservoir T stop.

cards.title: The 1.5-Mile Loop
cards.subtitle: Beacon Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk or jog the scenic 1.5-mile perimeter path of this historic reservoir, a favorite off-campus recreation spot for the BC community.
cards.short_summary: A historic reservoir with a popular perimeter walking path located directly adjacent to the BC campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chestnut Hill Reservoir is a key off-campus recreation area for students, featuring a perimeter path used for walking and jogging.
cards.source_title: Chestnut Hill Reservoir - Facilities - Boston College Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open daily for public use; located across from the main campus entrance.

cards.title: Community Service Core
cards.subtitle: Washington Street Corridor
cards.notes: Engage with the local community at the BC Neighborhood Center, located in the heart of this historic commercial district.
cards.short_summary: A historic neighborhood center on Washington Street that serves as the primary link between BC and the Brighton community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Boston College Neighborhood Center is located at 480 Washington Street in the heart of Brighton Center, facilitating student volunteer partnerships.
cards.access_notes: The BC Neighborhood Center is open for student volunteers and community members.

cards.title: Art and Administration
cards.subtitle: Commonwealth Avenue
cards.notes: Visit the McMullen Museum of Art or administrative offices along this stretch of Comm Ave that connects the main and Brighton campuses.
cards.short_summary: The section of Commonwealth Avenue housing BC's Brighton Campus, including the McMullen Museum of Art.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brighton Campus, located across Commonwealth Avenue from the main campus, houses the McMullen Museum of Art and various administrative offices.
cards.source_title: Campuses, Maps & Directions - About BC - Boston College
cards.access_notes: The McMullen Museum is free and open to the public; accessible via the BC Shuttle.

cards.title: The Human Resources Hub
cards.subtitle: Lake Street and Commonwealth Avenue
cards.notes: Find the Department of Human Resources and other university services in the repurposed historic buildings along this quiet residential street.
cards.short_summary: A street on the Brighton Campus containing key university administrative buildings like 129 Lake Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Department of Human Resources is located at 129 Lake Street on the Brighton Campus.
cards.access_notes: Visitor parking is available in front of the building at 129 Lake Street.

cards.title: Open-Air Retail District
cards.subtitle: Boylston Street (Route 9)
cards.notes: Walk through this upscale open-air shopping area featuring a variety of retail shops, a cinema, and student-friendly study spots like Blue Bottle Coffee.
cards.short_summary: A walkable open-air shopping and dining district located a short distance from campus in Chestnut Hill.
cards.evidence_claim: The Street is an open-air shopping district in Chestnut Hill that serves as a local retail and dining destination.
cards.source_title: The Street Chestnut Hill | Open-Air Shopping District in Chestnut Hill, MA
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible walkways; individual business hours vary.

cards.title: Off-Campus Living Corridor
cards.subtitle: Chiswick Road and Commonwealth Avenue
cards.notes: Navigate this residential corridor known for its high density of off-campus student housing and its own dedicated Green Line B branch stop.
cards.short_summary: A residential street in Brighton popular for off-campus student housing with a dedicated MBTA stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Chiswick Road is a light rail station on the MBTA Green Line B branch and is a primary location for off-campus student housing.
cards.access_notes: The T station is located in the median of Commonwealth Avenue at Chiswick Road.

cards.title: The Reservoir Edge
cards.subtitle: South Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk this quiet residential street that borders the reservoir and provides a direct pedestrian link between Cleveland Circle and the BC campus.
cards.short_summary: A residential corridor bordering the Chestnut Hill Reservoir that connects Cleveland Circle to the university.
cards.evidence_claim: South Street is a residential area located just outside Cleveland Circle, offering apartments within walking distance to the BC campus.
cards.source_title: 31-35 South Street Apartments | Boston College | Off-Campus Housing Search
cards.access_notes: Public residential street with sidewalk access to the reservoir path.

cards.title: Historic Commercial Link
cards.subtitle: Market Street and Washington Street
cards.notes: Explore the historic commercial roots of Brighton along this street, which once served as a major cattle market and now hosts local businesses.
cards.short_summary: A historic commercial street in Brighton that connects Brighton Center to the Charles River.
cards.evidence_claim: Market Street is a historic thoroughfare in Brighton, dating back to the 1650s and formerly known for its weekly cattle market.
cards.source_title: Market Street, Brighton MA - BAHS Home
cards.access_notes: Public street with various retail and dining establishments.

cards.title: Ice Cream and Tacos
cards.subtitle: Commonwealth Avenue at Lake Street
cards.notes: Visit the immediate off-campus block featuring student favorites like White Mountain Creamery and El Pelon Taqueria, right across from the main gate.
cards.short_summary: The commercial block directly across from BC's main entrance on Commonwealth Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: White Mountain Creamery and El Pelon Taqueria are popular student hangouts located directly across the street from the BC campus.
cards.access_notes: Located at the intersection of Commonwealth Avenue and Lake Street.
